comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Professional advisory firm delivering tax, valuation and consulting for funds and wealthy clients, not cloud software for consumers and small businesses.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Cloud payroll and tax filing software for small and mid-sized businesses, subscription-based, overlapping Intuit's payroll and small business software.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Large-scale HCM, payroll and PEO provider serving all employer sizes; overlaps in payroll but lacks accounting, consumer tax and marketplace.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Cloud software for nonprofits and schools; different customers and products despite payment processing and financial management overlap.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Mid-market HCM and payroll software; only the payroll line overlaps Intuit, with no accounting, consumer tax or personal finance.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Small business cloud SaaS with invoicing, payments and marketing services sold to small businesses, similar to Intuit's QuickBooks and Mailchimp.
